Ivanhoe, Banyule

Ivanhoe sits in the northern half of Melbourne, inside Banyule. Ivanhoe has roughly 12,171 residents. No Ivanhoe surcharge exists, because Dallas 3047 is close enough to Ivanhoe that one would be hard to justify.

Roughly 20 searches a month name Ivanhoe specifically, which is what earned Ivanhoe a page. Ivanhoe also registers about 20 a month for the glass, which is why the two are usually quoted together.

No Ivanhoe job is on the public record. That is a gap in what we can prove about Ivanhoe rather than a gap in where we take gutters.

Fascia

The damage a full gutter does

Rust comes from the inside

A steel gutter corrodes where the wet material sits, which is the surface nobody can see from the ground or from the roof.

Timber fascia rots quietly

Held wet by a full gutter for several winters. By the time paint is lifting the timber underneath has usually gone.

We report, we do not repair

Photographs of what is there, and an honest statement that replacement is a different trade.
